title: PieceDefinition
description: A purchasable/collectible chess piece TYPE. Instance state (remaining durability, rarity) lives in run.schema.json, never here: rarity belongs to an instance, not a type. See docs/06-deck-durability-and-permadeath.md.

value.description: Chess material value (P1 N3 B3 R5 Q9). King is 0 and is never counted.

cost.description: Act I shop price in coins. null = not purchasable.

durabilityMax.description: Deployments per purchase. null = immortal (king only).

notes.description: Design intent. Not shown to players.

allOf.$comment: Only the king may be immortal, and the king may never be sold.
